comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 detects whether any comment quotes the OP's title or argument verbatim or near-verbatim, and endorsement is not required. Feature 1 detects whether any comment gives reasoned evidence or argument opposing the OP's view, and it does not depend on quoting. A comment can quote the OP without making a counterargument. A comment can also make a counterargument without quoting. The null rules also differ.
